product.title: Front Office: Build the Roster
product.summary: Build a team under a salary cap, then absorb an owner's curveball.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students pick a GM style that sets their budget, sign and release from a 16-player pool while four meters move, then a random Owner's Curveball changes the target mid-build and forces a repair. They finish with a GM score and a short written memo.

facilitation.notes: plan.md is a build spec, not a teacher-facing guide. The repo also ships an interactive xlsx carrying the same claim code, so the lesson can run without browsers.

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

additional.path: Copy of Be The GM(Salary Cap)-101M1L1.xlsx

governance.maturityBasis: Runs end-to-end, publicly reachable, and carries in-browser self-tests. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: Playtested end to end 2026-08-16. Real roster, live meters, a randomised owner curveball, and a genuine failure state — a deliberately poor build scored 51 against 99 for a strong one.
knownBlockers: The final report always prints the same curveball verdict text ("carry at least 9 players") regardless of which curveball was actually issued, including when the real one was marked complete.

provenance.evidence: T101-M1-L1/plan.md: 'A single-file (index.html), framework-free sports-business simulation for 5th–6th graders.' Companion xlsx reveals the same claim code 'L1-101-M1-67' as the browser build, so the two are one experience in two media.
